Stores transfer information for a specific device. Includes denormalized senderDeviceId and receiverDeviceId for authorization.

params.name: deviceId
params.description: The ID of the device initiating the transfer.

firestore.reasoning: The Firestore structure prioritizes authorization independence and QAPs. Devices are stored at the top level, and transfers are stored as a subcollection under each device to track transfers initiated by each device. This structure facilitates simple, robust, and easily debuggable security rules because all documents in a collection share the same security requirements. The 'nearby' functionality is handled via the `Device` collection and requires read access to this collection to implement device discovery.
